1 Merge Sort with Four Sub-problems
Merge sort which divides the array of size n recursively into four sub-arrays of size n/4 to sort it with a separate
Merge() procedure which merges four sorted arrays.
Algorithm 1 Merge-Sort(A, low, high)
1: if low < high then
2: mid2 = low + (high−low)/2 . Middle point of the entire array
3: mid1 = low + (mid2−low)/2 . Middle point of the array A[low . . . mid2]
4: mid3 = (mid2 + 1) + (high−(mid2+1))/2 . Middle point of the array A[mid2 + 1 . . . high]
5: Merge-Sort(A, low, mid1)
6: Merge-Sort(A, mid1 + 1, mid2)
7: Merge-Sort(A, mid2 + 1, mid3)
8: Merge-Sort(A, mid3 + 1, high)
9: Merge(A, low, high, mid1, mid2, mid3) . Merge four sorted sub-arrays
10: end if
